authorization: User requested actual diagnosis of Ideas 1B, 3 and 4A after feasibility review.
scope: CPU-only bounded geometric feasibility, source-label representation and path/velocity consistency; no learning-effectiveness claim.

ownership.root: orchestration, evidence review, integration and final checks

idea1b.inputs: Existing 24 FULL_S6000 requests from r2_partial_edge_binding_v1; same original C, POST topology, pre_geo corners, clusters, source identities, queries and RAW labels.
idea1b.transform: One positive diagonal global affine transform of F around C bbox center; exact C shared-vertex anchors constrained by coordinate-axis elimination.
idea1b.optimization: Identity start, deterministic bounded Powell, at most 300 objective evaluations/request including identity; no restarts or threshold sweeps.
idea1b.objective: Length-weighted mean of 32 fixed midpoint samples per original C boundary edge to finite original F open edges after transformation; no GT or reward selection.
idea1b.final_evaluation: Affine-only and affine-plus-original-B2; 48 new final geometric score cells maximum. Original POST and B2 controls reused from immutable caches.
idea1b.binding_budget: Original B2 cluster-assignment 2%L relative to transformed pre_geo. Record affine displacement, binding displacement and total displacement from original pre_geo separately.
idea1b.limits: Optimizer non-convergence does not prove impossibility. Original RAW adoption is only a screening label, not review of modified POST. No new learned policy or representation.

idea3.inputs: Existing FULL training condition manifest (47 eligible source conditions) and six-parent FULL evaluation C metadata.
idea3.diagnosis: Original C boundary identities, legal source C/Y interfaces, number of C edges per source Y face, capacity/null requirements and compatibility with existing free-only OT/corner permutations.
idea3.small_controls: Shared-index legal edge, geometric-only T-junction, overloaded C edge, degenerate third corner, and isolated attached flap; CPU geometry only.
idea3.limits: Source completion provides supervision feasibility, not unique-GT success ranking. No seam-slot neural network or training.

idea4a.inputs: First four conditions in frozen FULL training manifest, existing source arrays and audited coordinate/OT/mask code.
idea4a.path: X_t=(1-t)Z+tY; S_t=I+g(t)A; b_t=g(t)d; g(t)=4t(1-t); Xtilde_t=S_t X_t+b_t.
idea4a.checks: CPU finite-difference derivatives, endpoints, C preservation, masks/face-corner correspondence, target-energy change and concrete training integration locations.
idea4a.limits: Correct path mathematics is not evidence of learned rollout improvement or conditional dependence. This is not DAgger. No model instantiation or forward.

prior_routes.idea1b: CREF coordinate/start adaptation, R27/RBF local restoration and partial-edge B2 binding; new diagnostic tests a common bounded global transform before fixed binding.
prior_routes.idea3: R10 post-hoc partner prediction and partial-edge binding; proposed difference is shared endpoint identity from the representation itself.
prior_routes.idea4a: R28 local readout, R29 endpoint reflow and R30 stochastic policy; proposed difference is a paired perturbation path and its analytically consistent velocity.

preservation: Original data, weights, source scorers, saved outputs and reports remain read-only. All new artifacts under this directory. No install, cleanup, default change, commit or push.
stop: Finish all three CPU diagnoses, summarize evidence and remaining uncertainty; do not launch follow-on training.
